s: Stripe, PayPal, webhooks, PCI compliance, subscription billing
d: Most commercial backends need payment processing. Stripe and PayPal handle the complexity, but you need to understand webhooks, idempotency, PCI compliance, subscription billing, and refund flows to build reliable payment systems.

p: Payment Systems is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.

2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
